node.title: Dually-spread flats: r-wise moment count gives C(n,r)/C(j,r) — poly to LOG dimension
node.statement: If w*(P-perp) > r: every r-subset of traces meets in exactly one point, so sum of C(mult, r) <= C(n,r), giving #(P cap D_j) <= C(n,r)/C(j,r) ~ (n/j)^r. HONEST SCOPE: poly(n) only for r = O(log n); in-band deficiencies r ~ n 2^-9 exceed this — high dimension MUST route through descent/structure, not moments.
